problem: Netlify production deploy for main SHA 0dc124fc2467641ad4c04f6a8ecbfad515b411e1 failed during stage 'building site' with build script exit code 2.
root_cause: tools/site-shell/pricing-build-integrity.mjs contained multiple JavaScript parse hazards: quote handling inside dynamic RegExp strings and over-escaped regex literals such as /<\\/body>/i. The first patch fixed the dynamic RegExp quoting, while the CI regression then exposed the remaining invalid regex-literal flags before another production deploy.
prevention: Every Node script referenced from netlify.toml [build].command must pass node --check in CI before merge.
Prefer RegExp constructors/template literals when a pattern contains nested slash and quote escaping that is easy to misread.
Do not over-escape forward slashes in JavaScript regex literals; use either a valid regex literal or a RegExp constructor consistently.
When Netlify reports build-script exit code 2, reproduce the exact build command and run node --check across the full build command before changing application logic.
Do not classify provider-auth success as production success; exact release.json SHA and browser readback remain mandatory.
